data.credibility: Management shows mixed reliability. They successfully delivered specific targets like the 83 Mark1A LCA initial units and grew the order book past projections. However, they frequently miss or quietly drop timelines for prototype rollouts, engine deliveries, and major cost-reduction or deal-concluding milestones.

lines.line: EBITDA margin averaged 31.0% in Q4 FY23, beating the 26% to 27% target.
ROH revenue growth reached 14.7%, but the target horizon was dropped after initial delays.
Cash balance target of Rs. 15,000 crore was not mentioned subsequently and was dropped.
Delivered 3 units for the 83 Mark1A LCA program in the scheduled year.
Double-digit revenue growth of 10% from FY25 onwards has been slipping.
Stabilized revenue growth target of 14% to 15% after FY25 remains slipping.
Order value target of INR 48,000 crores was dropped without further mentions.
Manpower cost target of 16% of revenue was dropped after initial guidance.
Estimated CAPEX of 14,000 to 15,000 crores for the next 5 years remains on track.
Outstanding order book reached 1,89,300 crores by March 2025, beating the 1,20,000 crore target.
Nashik third line for LCA became operational after initial delays, fulfilling the goal.
Operating profit to revenue stands at 24.9% recently, slipping from the 27% target.
Delivered 0 of the targeted 12 LCA engines, resulting in a missed status.
Tejas Mark-2 prototype flight in Q1 FY27 is delayed, keeping it slipping.
GE F414 engine deal conclusion target for FY26 is slipping.
Capacity target of 30 LCA aircraft per annum in two years remains on track.
Pending plan to invest INR 12,000 crores in infrastructure projects by 2030.
Pending target to receive INR 90,000 crores in orders during the next 2 years.
Pending rollout of Tejas Mark II prototype by March of current financial year.

bull: Net profit compounded at 23.0% annually over five years, accompanied by an operating cash flow at 144% of reported profit.
Outstanding order book surged to 1,89,300 crores by March 2025, substantially outperforming prior 1,20,000 crore expectations.
The company is almost debt-free with borrowings of only ₹10 cr against a net worth of ₹43,999 cr.
bear: Working-capital days severely stretched from 141 to 301 over the past five years.
Operating profit margin recently fell to 24.9%, slipping below the guided 27% target.
Management missed its target to deliver 12 LCA engines in CY25 and delayed the Tejas Mark-2 prototype flight.
